title: Disconnect acknowledgement (v1.0.4)
description: Signed (X-AOS-Response-*) with the inbound key of the same generation as the request. After it, the OS holds no keys for the site.

idempotentReplay.description: v1.0.1: true on a response replayed from the idempotency store (EmDash strips the X-AOS-Idempotent-Replay header)
